findings.evidence: Lines 79–84, 121–125, 149–153, 167–171, 183–187, 199–203, 216–220, and 233–237 each consist solely of invoking the existing theorem with `hΩopen.mem_nhds ha`; Mathlib defines `IsOpen.mem_nhds` at `Mathlib/Topology/Neighborhoods.lean:90`.
findings.fix: Delete them and pass `hΩopen.mem_nhds ha` directly; update the dichotomy proof similarly.
findings.issue: All eight `_of_isOpen` declarations are redundant special cases of the corresponding neighborhood-based theorems.

findings.evidence: Lines 177–180 and 193–196 are exactly these one-line conversions; Mathlib already provides `IsLocalMinOn.isLocalMin` and `IsLocalMaxOn.isLocalMax` at `Mathlib/Topology/Order/LocalExtr.lean:123–130`.
findings.fix: Delete both declarations and call `eqOn_const_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_isLocalMax` or `...isLocalMin` with `hmax.isLocalMax hΩa` or `hmin.isLocalMin hΩa`.
findings.issue: The new `IsLocalMaxOn` and `IsLocalMinOn` theorems duplicate the existing `IsLocalMax`/`IsLocalMin` results because the assumed `Ω ∈ 𝓝 a` converts the relative extrema immediately.

summary: The PR adds ten thin specializations of existing APIs; callers can obtain every result directly with existing Mathlib conversion lemmas.
